name: NM-01
label: Safe D

key_factors: Polymarket prices her at 94% to win
No public polling of the race
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Stansbury: a Democratic-leaning Albuquerque seat, incumbency, and a dominant money edge over a little-funded challenger. Markets price her near-certain, and nothing in the evidence suggests moving off the baseline margin of about 19.5 points.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race, or a major national wave toward Republicans, would be the main threat to this forecast.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Melanie Stansbury seeks a second full term in a Democratic-leaning Albuquerque-area district that backed her party by about seven points at the presidential level. She has raised roughly $1.35 million and holds a large cash advantage over Republican Didi Okpareke, who has raised about $100,000. Outside spending has favored Stansbury, with no recorded spending against her.

Prediction markets give Stansbury about a 94 percent chance of winning, and no public polls of the race have been conducted. With no expert ratings available, the forecast rests on the district's lean, incumbency, and the financial gap, all of which point to a comfortable Stansbury win.
